title: 第7章 阴谋第8章 猛虎帮第9章 帮忙
content_zh:
第7章阴谋
空寂大师扭过头，看看自己旁边的小沙弥，然后又望了望前面的青阳和皮有凤，笑道：“你徒儿青阳也不差啊，看着聪明伶俐，想必也是尽得你松鹤老道的真传？还有这位皮家的小姑娘，身上的本事恐怕也不容小看。”
大家都是西平府的江湖人物，相互之间多多少少都有了解，不过平时很少有机会聚在一起，大家又寒暄了几句，庆阳的师父松鹤老道终于问出了自己心中的疑惑，道：“今天到底是什么日子？大家怎么会齐聚我的西平观？”
西平观位置偏僻，以前十天半月都见不到一个外人，今天却接二连三的有人上山，就连平时在寺里静修，几乎不出门的空寂大师都来了，这事实在是太异常了。青阳师徒也是江湖中人，却也没听说最近发生过什么大事，听了松鹤老道的话，空寂大师比他更疑惑，道：“不是你给我发的邀约吗？怎么你自己都不清楚？”
“我发出的邀约？”松鹤老道疑惑道。
青阳也很疑惑，他一直跟师父生活在一起，最近也没见师父向江湖人士发什么请帖，可看空寂大师的样子，这一切似乎又都是真的，难道师父背着自己做下了什么大事？不过看着师父眉头紧皱的样子，似乎又没有这回事，这可就怪了。
这时钱半仙也说道：“我也是接到了松鹤真人的邀请才过来赴约的，没想到半路上会遇到这个姓杜的，早知道我就不来了。”
这下就不好说了，若是空寂大师一个人弄错还有可能，连钱半仙也这么说，这事十有八九是真的。他们肯定都是接到了自己的邀约，至于是不是自己发出的，就不好说了。
这事透着蹊跷，大家又把目光投向了皮家父女，想看看他们是不是也像空寂大师和钱半仙一样，接到了邀约。
被这么多人同时注视，那皮应熊表情都有些不自然了，道：“我倒不是来赴什么约，而是有人要买一只训好的狸猫，除了双倍的价钱，让我送到西平观，于是我和女儿就来到了这里。”
最后剩下的那个杜成金，不用大家发问，直接开口说道：“我也没接到了什么邀约，只是有人告诉我，说是钱半仙这两天会在西平观出现，我那时候恨不得生撕了他，自然就在第一时间过来了，后来果然在半路上堵住了钱半仙。”
青阳皱着眉头想到，空寂大师这样的方外之人，一般的方法很难让他出门，也只有师父松鹤老道的邀约才能把他引过来；钱半仙离这里最近，跟师父又是半个同行，用师父松鹤真人的名义自然可以；而皮家父女与师父没什么交情，只有生意才能让他亲自跑一趟；至于杜成金，最近找钱半仙都找疯了，用钱半仙把他引过来，肯定是最省事的办法。
对这四家人，分别用了不同的方法，而且都是极有针对性的方法，若是对他们不熟悉，肯定做不出来。仔细想来，这是就有些骇人了，这到底是谁做的？目的又是什么呢？会不会对大家不利？
这是钱半仙也不知是想到了什么，忽然就打了一个哆嗦，道：“你们看这其中不会有什么阴谋吧？”
杜成金也道：“是啊，这事越想越吓人。”
松鹤老道还在思索着事情的蹊跷之处，空寂大师也沉吟着半天没有说话，只有皮应熊，似乎一点都不在乎，道：“光天化日之下，能有什么阴谋？就算是有阴谋，大家也不用怕，咱们西平府的顶尖高手大半都聚集在这里，其中更有松鹤真人和空寂大师坐镇，谁吃了熊心豹子胆，敢随便招惹我们？”
皮应熊这么一说，杜成金倒是松了一口气，不过钱半仙却说道：“那可不一定，对方既然敢把大家都骗过来，肯定是做好了充分的准备，说不定早就准备好了专门对付我们几个的手段？何况人心隔肚皮，谁又敢保证这里有没有对方的眼线和奸细？”
听钱半仙这么一说，原本因为这件而有些同病相怜的众人，顿时就起了一层隔阂。是啊，俗话不都说过吗，害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无嘛。尤其是那个杜成金，吓得腿都有点哆嗦了，放眼四顾，看谁都像是暗藏祸心的歹人。
在场的都是前辈，本轮不到青阳这个小辈说话，只是眼见大家戒心越来越重，谁也不信任谁，青阳只好插嘴道：“兵来将挡水来土掩，不管这事有没有阴谋，说其他的都没用，现在最重要的是弄清楚这事是谁干的，其中又有什么阴谋，才能有所准备。”
青阳的话似乎很能安定人心，那杜成金连忙附和道：“对，对，还是松鹤真人的高徒有见地。”

这时师父松鹤真人顺势说道：“这事虽然蹊跷，其中还是有些规律可循的，虽然对方把大家骗来的方式不同，但最终的目的都是来西平观，既然大家都来了，那幕后的主人应该也快现身了吧？”
空寂大师点了点头，轻轻地捋了捋自己的胡子，道：“这种诡异的行事风格，很像是开元府的那个猛虎帮啊！”
青阳也听说过这个猛虎帮，开元府也是梁州下面的一个府城，与西平府紧邻，相互之间多有来往，不过开元府的黑道江湖并不像西平府这么平静，私下里争斗很是激烈。尤其是最近十几年，开元府新崛起了一个猛虎帮，行事霸道，作风诡异，实力强劲，很快就称霸了整个开元府。
谁知那猛虎帮却仍不满足，最近又把目光投向了距离他们最近的西平府地界，这两年对这边屡屡试探，让西平府的江湖人士倍感压力。若说这件事是那猛虎帮做的，倒是很有可能。
听空寂大师提到开元府的猛虎帮，其他人也顿时开了窍，杜成金道：“那猛虎帮一直对我们西平府的地盘虎视眈眈，莫非他们终于做出进攻西平府的打算，这次准备把我们都聚集起来一网打尽？”
“那我们这些人岂不是要大祸临头了？”钱半仙颤抖着道。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 7 Conspiracy
Master Kongji turned his head and looked at the little novice monk next to him, then looked at Qingyang and Pi Youfeng in front of him, and said with a smile: "Your disciple Qingyang is not bad at all. He looks very smart, and he must be the true successor of your Songhe master? And this little girl from the Pi family, I'm afraid her abilities should not be underestimated."
Everyone is a figure in Xiping Mansion, and they know each other more or less, but they rarely have the opportunity to get together. After everyone exchanged a few words, Qingyang's master Songhe Laodao finally asked the doubts in his heart, saying: "What day is today? How come everyone gathers in my Xiping Temple?"
Xiping Temple is located in a remote place. In the past ten days and a half, no outsider could be seen. Today, people came up the mountain one after another. Even Master Kongji, who usually meditates in the temple and rarely goes out, came. This fact is really abnormal. Master Qingyang and his disciples are also people in the world, but they have not heard of any major events that have happened recently. After listening to Old Taoist Songhe, Master Kongji was even more confused than him, and said: "Isn't it the invitation you sent me? Why don't you know it yourself?"
"The invitation I sent out?" Old Taoist Songhe asked doubtfully.
Qingyang is also very confused. He has been living with his master and has not seen his master send any invitations to people in the world recently. But looking at Master Kongji's appearance, all this seems to be true. Could it be that his master has done something big behind his back? But looking at the frown on Master's face, it seemed that this was not the case, which was strange.
At this time, Qian Banxian also said: "I also came here for the appointment after receiving an invitation from Master Songhe. I didn't expect to meet this man named Du on the way. If I had known about it, I wouldn't have come."
It's hard to say now. If Master Kongji alone makes a mistake, it's possible. Even Qian Banxian said so, and it's nine out of ten that it's true. They must have received their invitations, but it's hard to say whether they sent them themselves.
There was something fishy about this matter, and everyone turned their attention to the Pi family and his daughter, wanting to see if they had received the invitation like Master Kongji and Qian Banxian.
Being watched by so many people at the same time, Pi Yingxiong's expression became a little unnatural, and he said: "I'm not here to keep an appointment, but someone wants to buy a trained civet cat. In addition to double the price, he asked me to send it to Xipingguan, so my daughter and I came here."
Du Chengjin, the last remaining one, didn't need to ask questions and said directly: "I didn't receive any invitations, but someone told me that Qian Banxian would appear at Xipingguan in the next two days. I wanted to kill him at that time, so naturally I came over as soon as possible, and then I blocked Qian Banxian on the way."
Qingyang frowned and thought that it would be difficult for an outsider like Master Kongji to go out using ordinary methods. Only Master Songhe’s invitation could bring him here; Of course it's okay in the name of Master He; but the Pi family's father and daughter have no relationship with the master, and only business can allow him to go there in person; as for Du Chengjin, he has been looking for money and half-immortals like crazy recently, so using money and half-immortals to lure him here is definitely the easiest way.
For these four families, different methods were used, and they were all very targeted methods. If you are not familiar with them, you will definitely not be able to do it. If you think about it carefully, this is a bit scary. Who did this? What is the purpose? Will it be detrimental to everyone?
Qian Banxian didn't know what he was thinking of, but he suddenly shuddered and said, "You don't think there is any conspiracy in this, right?"
Du Chengjin also said: "Yes, the more I think about it, the more scary it becomes."
Old Taoist Songhe was still thinking about the strangeness of the matter. Master Kongji also pondered for a long time without saying anything. Only Pi Yingxiong seemed not to care at all and said: "What kind of conspiracy can there be in broad daylight? Even if it isIf there is a conspiracy, don't be afraid. Most of the top experts in Xiping Mansion are gathered here, including Master Songhe and Master Kongji. Who dares to provoke us casually because of the courage of a bear and a leopard? "
When Pi Yingxiong said this, Du Chengjin breathed a sigh of relief, but Qian Banxian said: "That's not necessarily true. Since the other party dares to deceive everyone, they must be fully prepared. Maybe they have already prepared special means to deal with a few of us? What's more, people's hearts are separated from each other. Who can guarantee whether there are spies and spies of the other party here? "
Hearing what Qian Banxian said, everyone who had some sympathy for this incident suddenly became estranged. Yes, as the saying goes, you can't have the intention to harm others, and you can't have the intention to guard against others. Especially Du Chengjin, his legs were shaking with fear. Looking around, everyone looked like a villain with hidden evil intentions.
Everyone present was senior, and it was Qingyang’s turn to speak. Seeing that everyone was getting more and more wary, and no one trusted anyone, Qingyang had no choice but to interrupt: "The soldiers are coming to cover up the water and the earth. Regardless of whether there is a conspiracy in this matter, it is useless to say anything else. The most important thing now is to find out who did this and what conspiracy is involved, so that we can be prepared. "
Qingyang's words seemed to be very reassuring, and Du Chengjin quickly agreed: "Yes, yes, Master Songhe is still a wise disciple. "
At this time, Master Song He took advantage of the situation and said: "Although this matter is strange, there are still some rules to follow. Although the other party deceives everyone in different ways, the ultimate goal is to come to Xiping to watch. Since everyone is here, the master behind the scenes should show up soon, right? "
Master Kongji nodded, gently stroked his beard, and said: "This weird behavior is very similar to the Tiger Gang in Kaiyuan Mansion! "
Qingyang has also heard of the Tiger Gang. Kaiyuan Mansion is also a city under Liangzhou. It is close to Xiping Mansion and they have many contacts with each other. However, the underworld in Kaiyuan Mansion is not as peaceful as Xiping Mansion, and the private fights are very fierce. Especially in the past ten years, a new Tiger Gang has emerged in Kaiyuan Mansion. They act domineeringly, have strange styles, and are powerful. They soon dominate the entire Kaiyuan Mansion.
Unexpectedly, the Tiger Gang is still not satisfied. Recently, they have set their sights on the territory of Xiping Prefecture, which is closest to them. They have repeatedly tested this area in the past two years, which has made the people in Xiping Prefecture feel even more pressure. If it is said that this matter was done by the Tiger Gang, it is very possible.
Hearing Master Kongji mention the Tiger Gang in Kaiyuan Mansion, others suddenly became enlightened. Du Chengjin said: "The Tiger Gang has been eyeing our territory in Xiping Mansion. Could it be that they have finally made plans to attack Xiping Mansion and are planning to gather us all together this time? "
“Then wouldn’t it be a disaster for us people? Qian Banxian said tremblingly.
(End of chapter)
